title: Member identifier leaked in claim-status debug logs
summary: claim-status-api emits the raw `memberId` into debug-level log records; downstream log shipping retains it. Revenue-cycle/billing context only — identifiers in this repo are opaque synthetic IDs (e.g. MBR-0001) that do not look like real PHI.
alert_body:
Service: claims-status-api
Log query: debug records containing a 4-digit numeric member-ref segment
First seen: 2026-09-12T07:50:00Z
Occurrences: 14 (steady rate)
Sample record excerpt (debug): event=claim_status_check memberId=MBR-0001 claimId=CLM-2381 ...
Expected behavior: the debug record should still allow trace correlation by claimId, but the memberId column must be `[Redacted]` not the raw value.
On-call: paged EM (Marcus), Revenue Cycle Platform
Runbook: none — first time this alert has fired for this service
notes_for_demo: The planted privacy/leak bug. Run Ticketdroid finds the planted bug, redacts `memberId` at the logger boundary (or stops passing it into the log payload), and returns a reviewable PR. The regression test fails before the fix and passes after.

title: Duplicate claim submission detected — claims-api
summary: Payer clearinghouse rejected claim CLM-2381 as a duplicate. Submission log shows two outbound POSTs for the same claim ~40s apart after a gateway timeout and automatic retry.
alert_body:
Monitor: claims-submission-duplicate-check
Service: claims-api (prod)
Claim ID: CLM-2381
Patient ID: PT-0417 (synthetic)
Payer: fixture-payer-01
First submission: 2026-09-10T05:11:22Z (timed out after 8000ms)
Retry submission: 2026-09-10T05:12:01Z (succeeded, HTTP 201)
Clearinghouse response: 277CA duplicate-claim flag, ref DUP-88213
On-call: paged EM (Marcus), Revenue Cycle Platform
Runbook: none — first time this alert has fired for this service
notes_for_demo: The planted claims-api bug. Run Ticketdroid starts a real Factory droid session that reproduces the duplicate submission, fixes the idempotency bug, and returns a reviewable PR.
